title: Ercel Orser — Blacksmith
description: Blacksmiths, like Ercel Orser, were an important trade, as they forged horseshoes, repaired plows, sharpened tools, and maintained machinery. Wheelwrights built and repaired wagons, while carpenters constructed barns, homes, and fences. Later, as tractors and other modern farm equipment appeared, the roles of these trades also changed.
